design.collect: Two parallel lanes off the one trigger: Gmail message:getAll (rolling 24h window) and Google Calendar event:getAll (today, recurring expanded). Each lane passes through an Aggregate node (aggregateAllItemData) so its agent receives one item instead of one per email/event.
agents: Email Triage Agent - buckets messages (needs reply today / waiting / FYI / noise) and extracts action items
Calendar Agent - builds the day timeline, flags conflicts and back-to-back blocks, finds focus time and prep work
Briefing Composer Agent - merges both specialist reports into HTML fragment sections (executeOnce)
design.model: One shared OpenAI Chat Model subnode wired to all three agents
design.join: Merge node, mode combine / combineByPosition, so the composer runs once on one item; it reads each specialist by explicit $('Node').item.json.output reference rather than $json
design.present: HTML node (generateHtmlTemplate) wraps the composer's fragments in a styled dashboard shell (header with date, card layout, urgent/conflict tags), then Gmail message:send delivers it as an HTML email
design.resilience: onError: continueRegularOutput on both Google fetch nodes so one failing source does not kill the briefing

friction: get_workflow_best_practices requires an undocumented 'technique' argument and errors on an empty argument object.
search_nodes takes 'queries' (array) but the obvious singular 'query' is rejected; the error is the only hint.
mcp_code.ps1 resolves -CodeFile relative to its own directory, so an absolute path silently becomes a doubled path. Bare filenames only.
update_workflow's setNodeParameter refuses the 'width' and 'height' paths on a stickyNote ('invalid or contains unsafe segments'), so sticky frames could not be resized after creation.

sticky(content, [nodes]) anchor-based sizing did not survive the save: the three notes came back at default size stacked at x=100, overlapping the left of the canvas. Fixed by repositioning them with setNodePosition.
The HTML node's generateHtmlTemplate output field is not in the type definitions; the downstream Gmail body assumes $json.html (the documented n8n behaviour) rather than a verified field name.
